newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty firms vs basket, T-bill payment ups depos.
newsitem.headline: Zloty firms vs basket, T-bill payment ups depos.

text.p: 1405 GMT - The Polish zloty closed at 3.03/2.95 pct from the trading band centre, stronger than Tuesday's 2.92/2.87 pct close after drifting near resistance at three percent from parity throughout the session, dealers said.
* It was at 3.0820/40 to the dollar, up from 3.0855/65 on Tuesday and at 1.8070/90 to the mark, up from 1.8080/95.
* Finance Minister Marek Belka said there was no room to cut the zloty crawling peg devaluation constant presently. He said yr/yr CPI fell below 18 pct in Feb from Jan 18.1 pct.
* O/N and T/N both rose to 22.00/22.50 pct from opening's 21.75/21.95 pct as banks payed for T-bills bought on Monday.
